item.unrendered_portal.scrap_metal.desc: The common one. Nearly every kill leaves some.
item.unrendered_portal.copper_wire.desc: Drawn and wound. The scarce one off a kill.
item.unrendered_portal.dense_alloy.desc: The mass in front of it.
item.unrendered_portal.battery.desc: Recharges the shield. Here: absorption hearts and a jolt of speed.
item.unrendered_portal.bullet.desc: Fired off the palm: a fast, flat bolt.
item.unrendered_portal.crab_fragment.des: A shard of a slain Crab-Core. Three make a core.
item.unrendered_portal.crab_core.desc: Throw it. It flattens what stands near it and leaves the ground alone.
item.unrendered_portal.repair_kit.desc: Mends the hull. Here: five hearts.
item.unrendered_portal.moonstone.desc: Cold, and faintly lit from inside.
item.unrendered_portal.sun_fragment.desc: One fifth of the way off a planet.
item.unrendered_portal.moon_fragment.des: One fifth of the way off a planet.
